This is one dissent recorded in a manifesto about sustaining human knowledge in the age of AI. Which fault line does it fall on?

Options:
- consent_or_payment: consent and payment mechanism: opt-in / levies / dues on existing text vs open training, pay at output, contracts for new work (Salib, Bratton, O'Reilly against the majority)
- model_in_loop: whether a model belongs in the checking loop or the room at all (Becker, Turkle)
- other: anything else

Text:

Declined to remove anthropomorphic verbs and calls these tools an epistemic gift as well as a risk.
raw: {"choice":"other","why":"The dissent concerns framing: it \"Declined to remove anthropomorphic verbs\" and calls the tools \"an epistemic gift as well as a risk.\" It says nothing about consent or payment for training text. It also does not address whether a model belongs in the checking loop or the room. It is a disagreement over language and overall stance toward AI, so neither named fault line fits."}
